name: Bless Hotel Madrid
positioning: BLESS Madrid, a Salamanca district hotel on Madrid's Golden Mile with an Art Deco bar and lounge at the entrance, a rooftop pool and a spa
best_for: Travelers who want a base among Salamanca's boutiques, restaurants and art galleries
Guests who enjoy a lively lounge scene with DJ sessions and cocktails

facts.text: The hotel's address is Calle de Velazquez 62 in Madrid.
The hotel operates under the Palladium Hotel Group.
The hotel's dining spaces are Picos Pardos Sky Lounge, Pinzelada Lounge, Blessed Breakfast and SLVJ.
The spa offers treatments by Beldon Wellness.
Hosted by is a hosted evening in which a menu created for the occasion is paired with an exhibition or fashion show.
Rooms have hardwood floors with area rugs and residential touches like faux fireplaces and crown molding.
Colon and the Paseo de la Castellana are within walking distance.
DJs often set up in the lobby.

highlights.text: The entrance opens onto an Art Deco bar and lounge with Oriental rugs and Murano glass pieces.
The hotel is in Madrid's Salamanca district, on the Golden Mile, surrounded by luxury boutiques, restaurants and art galleries.
The hotel has a rooftop pool with views, and the Wellbeing Terrace Villa is equipped with a jacuzzi and Hogo Beds.
Pinzelada Lounge hosts art in a collection created with the Maria Porto gallery, and holds DJ sessions with signature cocktails on several evenings a week, called Sips and Sounds.
Through a collaboration with La Finca Golf, the hotel offers its guests access to the course.

considerations.text: Reception is tucked away in a corner, past the bar and lounge; Conde Nast Traveler notes that traditionalists may find the entrance through the bar and lounge a bit disjointed.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
